name: Adapting and improving models for new situations
gist: Making vision models work reliably when the data shifts from training to the real world, or when they encounter new domains or tasks.
explain: A model trained on one dataset often fails on another. Train a face recognition system on photos from the internet and it might fail on security camera footage, which has different lighting, angles, and image quality. Train an object detector on sunny outdoor images and it fails in snow or rain. This domain shift — the mismatch between training data and real-world data — is one of computer vision's most practical problems. The research question is: how can we make models work reliably when data changes between training and deployment without retraining from scratch on expensive new labeled data?

The difficulty is that models learn superficial patterns, not deep concepts. A detector trained on synthetic rendered images learns to respond to digital artifacts and perfect shadows, not the features that matter for real photos. A model trained on one city learns city-specific cues, not what 'car' really is. When the data distribution shifts — new lighting, new camera, new domain — these superficial patterns fail. Simply collecting more labeled data is expensive and never covers all possible variations. Ideally, a model should adapt on its own, either by using unlabeled data from the new domain or by learning in a more generalizable way in the first place.

Researchers tackle this from several angles. Some use transfer learning: train a model on a large source dataset, then fine-tune it on a small amount of labeled target data. Others use domain adaptation: learn a mapping between source and target domains so that features become domain-invariant. Some use self-supervised learning on unlabeled target data — solve a task like predicting masked image patches to learn representations without labels. Others focus on test-time adaptation: during deployment, let the model update its internal settings (like how it normalizes pixel statistics) based on the stream of real data it sees, so it gradually adjusts to the new distribution. A few use meta-learning: train the model to adapt quickly to new tasks with few examples. The goal is generalization: models that work in messy reality, not just in controlled settings.

papers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing VLM for Compressed Image Understanding
papers.contribution: Proposes a universal VLM adaptor that improves performance across varying codecs and bitrates by 10%-30% through identifying that only generalization gap can be mitigated for compressed images.

papers.title: DRFusion: Drift-Resilient Temporally Consistent Infrared–Visible Video Fusion
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance in both fusion quality and temporal stability.

papers.title: Exploiting Low-Dimensional Manifold of Features for Few-shot Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art few-shot WSI classification with significantly fewer parameters via geometry-aware learning.

papers.title: Identity-Free Deferral For Unseen Experts
papers.contribution: IFD consistently improves generalization to unseen experts on medical imaging benchmarks and ImageNet-16H with real human annotators by removing identity conditioning shortcuts.

papers.title: MAC-NeRF: Motion-Aware Curriculum Learning for Dynamic LiDAR NeRFs
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on KITTI-360 and nuScenes dynamic scene rendering via curriculum learning.

papers.title: Prototype-Based Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: PTA improves CLIP accuracy from 65.64% to 69.38% on 10 cross-domain benchmarks while retaining 92% inference speed, state-of-the-art on 15 image and 4 point cloud benchmarks.

papers.title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers
papers.contribution: RF-DETR achieves 48.0 AP on COCO (beating D-FINE by 5.3 AP) and is the first real-time detector to surpass 60 AP on COCO.

papers.title: Understanding Dataset Distillation via Spectral Filtering
papers.contribution: UniDD reveals that DD fundamentally matches frequency-specific features and proposes Curriculum Frequency Matching (CFM) that gradually adjusts filter parameters to cover both low- and high-frequency information.

papers.title: AnyUp: Universal Feature Upsampling
papers.contribution: Sets state-of-the-art upsampling performance, generalizes to different feature types, preserves feature semantics while being efficient for diverse downstream tasks.

papers.title: Blocking the Leakage: Manifold-Aware Gradient Projection for Long-Horizon Test-Time Adaptation
papers.contribution: Achieves long-horizon stability on diverse TTA benchmarks where prior methods collapse.

papers.title: Breaking the Synthetic-Real Domain Shortcut for Training-Free Generative Replay-based Class Incremental Learning
papers.contribution: Achieve state-of-the-art class-incremental learning performance without exemplar replay using training-free generation.

papers.title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval
papers.contribution: Improves performance on YouCook2 and CrossTask, remains competitive on COIN, and provides useful reranking signals for black-box video generation candidates.

papers.title: Calibrated Knowledge Aggregation in Bayesian Mixture-of-Experts for Continual VQA
papers.contribution: Reaches 64.16 accuracy with 0.63 forgetting on VQA-v2 (+5.74% accuracy, -2.99 forgetting vs prior methods) with improved calibration.

papers.title: Continual GUI Agents
papers.contribution: Surpasses baselines and establishes first continual learning framework for GUI agents under distribution shift.

papers.title: D$^2$O: A Dual Debiasing Operator for Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation of Vision–Language Models
papers.contribution: Achieves clearest gains under style/environment shifts, with broader gains elsewhere, composing plug-and-play with retrieval-based and Gaussian adapters.

papers.title: Don't Forget Why You Started: Tackling Dual Forgetting in Vision-Language Continual Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art balance in preserving both incremental and pre-trained knowledge; SCR metric reveals hidden fragility of existing methods.

papers.title: FOVI: A biologically-inspired foveated interface for deep vision models
papers.contribution: FOVI and its foveated ViT adaptation (via LoRA) achieve competitive performance with a fraction of pixels and computational cost compared to non-foveated baselines.

papers.title: FiSeR: Fine-Grained Source Representations for Cross-Domain AI Image Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves average AUROC gain of +10.22 on cross-domain evaluation and +10.64 to +17.41 on few-shot adaptation over baseline DIRE across four benchmark datasets.

papers.title: From Perception to Planning: Evolving Ego-Centric Task-Oriented Spatiotemporal Reasoning via Curriculum Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 92.4% accuracy on long-horizon logical reasoning and 88.2% fine-grained perceptual precision, eliminating chronological biases.

papers.title: Hystar: Hypernetwork-driven Style-adaptive Retrieval via Dynamic SVD Modulation
papers.contribution: Hystar achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-style retrieval and cross-style classification benchmarks with parameter efficiency.

papers.title: Learning Hierarchical and Geometry-Aware Graph Representations for Text-to-CAD
papers.contribution: The approach improves geometric fidelity and constraint satisfaction by narrowing the search space and enabling the model to handle more complex assemblies.

papers.title: MapUQ: Map with Uncertainty Quantification for Robust BEV Vectorized Construction
papers.contribution: Outperform prior approaches with average AP improvement of 1.5% across three road types and significantly improve uncertainty metrics ECE and NLL.

papers.title: Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation with Bayesian Conditional Priors
papers.contribution: BCP outperforms strong TTA baselines, improving RN50 average mAP from 57.31 to 69.22 and ViT-B/16 from 62.61 to 71.79 without target annotations.

papers.title: PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation
papers.contribution: Generates geometrically accurate and temporally consistent depth sequences for panoramic video, enabling VR and world model applications.

papers.title: Plan, Decouple, Assimilate: Physics-Aware Object Insertion in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.contribution: PDA reduces whole-image FID by 15.7% over the strongest baseline and boosts downstream detection mAP50 by +17.07 points over real data.

papers.title: Resolution as a Direction: Vector-Panning Feature Alignment for Cross-Resolution Re-Identification
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on multiple CR-ReID benchmarks with improved efficiency compared to super-resolution or jointly trained alternatives.

papers.title: Robust Test-time Video-Text Retrieval: Benchmarking and Adapting for Query Shifts
papers.contribution: HAT-VTR substantially improves robustness across diverse query shift scenarios, enhancing model reliability for real-world video-text retrieval applications.

papers.title: Scale-Aware Domain Harmonization for Domain Adaptation Person Search
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on CUHK-SYSU (82.3% mAP, 84.0% top-1) and PRW (41.7% mAP, 82.4% top-1) datasets.

papers.title: SkelHCC: A Hyperbolic CLIP-Driven Cache Adaptation Framework for Skeleton-based One-Shot Action Recognition
papers.contribution: SkelHCC outperforms state-of-the-art methods on NTU RGB+D 60/120 and PKU-MMD II datasets for one-shot action recognition.

papers.title: SpaceControl: Introducing Test-Time Spatial Control to 3D Generative Modeling
papers.contribution: SpaceControl outperforms training-based and optimization-based baselines in geometric faithfulness while preserving visual quality in quantitative evaluation and user studies.

papers.title: Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on VTG benchmarks with progressive curriculum evolving from constructed to autonomous reasoning.

papers.title: X-MoGe: A Cross-Modal Adaptation Framework with Mixture-of-Experts and Geometry Guidance for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on OPV2V and DAIR-V2X datasets for heterogeneous collaborative perception.

papers.title: ZeroSiam: An Efficient Siamese for Test-Time Entropy Optimization without Collapse
papers.contribution: ZeroSiam avoids collapse with negligible overhead and performs stably across vision and language tasks with diverse models including collapse-prone tiny models.
